keyA.notes: p129 continues p128 mid-sentence («فَكَانَ يَبِيتُ / عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ») -> '+'. p130 continues p129 mid-sentence («الْحَسِيبِ / النَّسِيبِ») -> '+'. p131 starts with item ٤٢ after p130 ended with a full stop -> no '+'. p132 continues p131 mid-sentence («لِلْأَكْوانِ الْيَدُ / الْعُلْيَا») -> '+'. Only p130 has a footnote (no continuation). Red divine Names: حَسِيبُ (p129), جَلِيلُ, كَرِيمُ (p131), رَقِيبُ (p132). The word الله printed with a damma (يَا اللهُ, صَلَّى اللهُ) is written اللَّهُ as in earlier batches; without a case vowel (أَرْقُبَ الله فِي خَلْقِهِ) it is written الله. Mark over lam+letter ligatures read as sukun+fatha (open hook) vs sukun+damma (filled blob) per earlier batches, e.g. الْمَعَاشِ (sukun+fatha) vs الْمُعَاشِ not printed. Quran encoded per Tanzil: 10:5 (لِتَعْلَمُوا۟ with small round zero; no waqf ۚ printed after وَٱلْحِسَابَ, verified, so none written), 8:64 (يَٰٓأَيُّهَا), 93:8. Commas printed without a following space (e.g. «جَمَالًا ،وَفِي», «وَرِفْعَةً،جَمِيلِ») normalized to '، '. Tatweel in «فَأَقُــومَ» (p132) dropped. Lines located with a row-darkness profile and read at 900-2000 dpi zooms.
